feature_plain.rainfall_mm_annual: How much rain fell on your farm this year
feature_plain.humidity_pct: How humid/damp the air is on your farm
feature_plain.temperature_c: The average temperature on your farm
feature_plain.altitude_m: How high up your farm is located
feature_plain.soil_ph: How acidic or alkaline your soil is
feature_plain.soil_drainage_score: How well water drains from your soil
feature_plain.farm_age_years: How many years your cocoa trees have been growing
feature_plain.farm_size_ha: The size of your farm in hectares
feature_plain.shade_tree_density: How many shade trees you have on the farm
feature_plain.pesticide_sprays_per_year: How many times you spray pesticides each year
feature_plain.pruning_regularity: How often you prune/cut back your cocoa trees
feature_plain.fertilizer_use: Whether and how much fertilizer you apply
feature_plain.irrigation: Whether you water your farm during dry seasons
feature_plain.tree_density_per_ha: Number of cocoa trees per hectare
feature_plain.dead_tree_pct: Percentage of trees that have died or are missing
feature_plain.pod_infection_visible_pct: Percentage of cocoa pods that look diseased
feature_plain.neighbour_farms_diseased_pct: How many nearby farms are already showing disease
feature_plain.forest_distance_km: How close your farm is to a forest
feature_plain.road_access: Whether your farm is easily reachable by road
feature_plain.extension_visits_per_year: How many times an extension officer visited your farm
feature_plain.coop_member: Whether you belong to a farmers' cooperative
